read: CallRail calls on the show number
Shopify orders with the show code
GA4 report for the show campaign

your_numbers.benchmark_basis: $63,000 spend on Google Ads, Meta Ads / 85 qualified leads from them

cost_lines.item: Hot tub delivery to the hall and back

open_pipeline_estimate.label: Estimate. Not added to measured ROI.

measured_result.status_reason: Last day 2026-03-15 plus the 90th-percentile 127 days to win is 2026-07-20; the run date is later.
measured_result.renewal_reason: Measured ROI is 308% and cost per qualified lead is $275.07, at or below the $741.18 the business pays through paid search and social.
measured_result.against_forecast: No forecast was made before the 2026 show, so there is nothing to compare.

findings.finding: The CRM undercounts the show: 22 of its 92 leads were logged under other sources
findings.impact: Counting only leads with the show's source value, cost per qualified lead looks like $341.76; with every matched lead it is $275.07.

findings.finding: 11 calls to the show number went unanswered during the show
findings.impact: 4 of those callers called back and became leads; 7 never called back and match no CRM lead.

findings.finding: 6 first-time callers whose calls were scored good leads never reached the CRM
findings.impact: They are counted as leads here, with no revenue, and are a follow-up gap.

findings.finding: The flyer QR code drew almost nothing
findings.impact: Flyers cost $450 and brought 29 sessions; the booth sign brought 418.

fixes_from_2026.fixes: The CRM undercounts the show: 22 of its 92 leads were logged under other sources
fixes_from_2026.action: Set the CRM source rule above before the show, so calls are not logged as Phone.

fixes_from_2026.fixes: 11 calls to the show number went unanswered during the show
fixes_from_2026.action: Forward the show number to a person on the stand with a backup line, Saturday and Sunday included.

fixes_from_2026.fixes: 6 first-time callers whose calls were scored good leads never reached the CRM
fixes_from_2026.action: Every good-lead call on the show number creates a CRM lead the same day.

fixes_from_2026.fixes: The flyer QR code drew almost nothing
fixes_from_2026.action: No flyers ($450 in 2026). Booth QR signage and a QR card on the demo hot tub are budgeted at $250 instead.

before: Email past quote requests that did not buy: the show dates, the stand number and the show-only offer.
Book backyard-visit appointments with known prospects for the show weekend, entered in the CRM under Home Show 2027.
Post the stand location and the offer on the business's own social pages two weeks out and the week of the show.
on_site: Three staff per shift: one on the demo hot tub, one booking backyard visits on a tablet straight into the CRM, one on the show phone.
Show-only offer: SHOW27 for 15% off supplies in the online store until 30 days after the show, plus a free water test.
Every conversation that agrees to a visit becomes a CRM lead before the person leaves the stand.
content: Short videos of the demo hot tub and the most asked questions at the stand.
A post after the show with photos and the offer's end date.
after: A named owner calls every qualified lead within 2 business days.
The follow-up email goes out the Tuesday after the show, with the followup_email link.
Run this report again after the capture window closes on 2027-04-13; it becomes final once 127 days have passed after the show.

assumptions_and_gaps: Soccer club: the 55% homeowner share and the 0.3%, 0.6% and 1.5% response rates are the user's estimates.
Gala: the 0.5%, 1% and 2% response rates are the user's estimates; the 80% homeowner share is the organiser's.
Show 2027: the 75% and 125% spread around the expected case is the skill's default; attendance is the organiser's projection.
Brand value (logos, stage mention, presenting title) is listed but not priced; no dollar value was given.
Open pipeline from the 2026 show (2 qualified leads) is an estimate and is not in measured ROI.
7 missed callers never called back and match no CRM lead, so their value is unknown.
